title: Duodenal biopsy - narrative canned report v3 (object text fields)

text.description: Write ONE paragraph of microscopy text in natural report style. Always include villous architecture (default: retained villous architecture) and IEL status (default: not increased). Only mention inflammation/duodenitis if explicitly stated. Mention crypt hyperplasia, gastric/foveolar metaplasia, villous blunting/atrophy, IEL increase only if stated/implied. Always end with: 'There is no dysplasia or malignancy.'

Write a short conclusion (1–2 sentences). MUST ALWAYS be non-empty. If coeliac-type features are present, include Marsh classification and advise correlation with anti‑tTG (and clinical context). Marsh mapping (assume crypt hyperplasia may be present even if not explicitly stated): Marsh 0 = retained/normal villi + no increase IEL; Marsh 1 = increased IEL with retained villi; Marsh 2 = increased IEL + crypt hyperplasia with retained villi; Marsh 3a = villous blunting/partial atrophy + increased IEL; Marsh 3b = subtotal villous atrophy + increased IEL; Marsh 3c = total villous atrophy/flat mucosa + increased IEL. If gastric metaplasia and/or duodenitis is present with normal IELs, conclude chronic/peptic-type duodenitis and state no features of coeliac disease. If entirely normal, conclude no features of coeliac disease and within normal limits.

comment_line.description: Optional extra line appended after the conclusion.
